extracted.name: No-Knead Skillet Olive Bread
extracted.description: This easy no-knead olive bread recipe is baked in a cast iron skillet for a crusty loaf packed with marinated olives, garlic, and herbs.
ingredient_lines: 2 cups lukewarm water (105 degrees F, 40 degrees C)
1 cup marinated olives (such as Star® Garlic & Basil) - drained, chopped, and herbs and garlic reserved
1 teaspoon dried parsley, or as needed
instruction_lines: Combine water and yeast in a large bowl. Add 1 cup flour and 1/2 tablespoon salt. Stir using a wooden spoon until combined. Stir in olives, reserved herbs and garlic, and garlic powder until incorporated. Add remaining flour 1 cup at a time, stirring until thoroughly combined. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and set in a warm spot until dough has doubled in size, about 1 hour.

Add 1 tablespoon olive oil to an 8-inch cast iron skillet and spread to coat the bottom and sides. Flour your hands. Remove plastic wrap from the bowl, transfer dough to the prepared skillet, and shape into a disc. Cover with a kitchen towel and let stand for 30 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
Drizzle remaining 1 tablespoons olive oil on top of the loaf and sprinkle with coarse salt and parsley. Score the top of the loaf about 1/2-inch deep with a sharp knife.
Bake in the preheated oven until the top is nicely browned, 30 to 35 minutes. Remove bread from the oven and turn out onto a wire rack to cool before serving, about 20 minutes.
